preconditions.description: The length of the hexadecimal string S must be at most 14.
At least one character in the string S must be non-zero.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S must be valid hexadecimal digits.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (len(stdout) == len(S) and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in stdout))
postconditions.description: The output must either be 'NO' or a valid hexadecimal string of the same length as S.

postconditions.expression: stdout != 'NO' and int(stdout, 16) + int(S, 16) == int(''.join(sorted(S, reverse=True)), 16)
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', the sum of the output and S must equal the largest possible permutation of S.

postconditions.expression: stdout != 'NO' and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', it must be a valid hexadecimal string.
